description: Lists the six broad shopping categories WEM covers (electronics, fashion, beauty, home, sports, collectibles), each with example products, plus the retailer sources currently enabled and the default currency (GBP). Use it to help a shopper narrow a vague request. It returns no prices, and the category names are labels for the shopper, not filter values.
name: get_categories

providers.description: Retailers currently enabled. WEM compares only feeds it is licensed to use.

title: List shopping categories
